fullPassage: On the day of her big audition, Fiona waited outside the theater, looking at the closed doors. Terrible thoughts ran through her head: "Am I good enough? What if I forget my lines?" It felt like a million butterflies were fluttering around her stomach. Suddenly, the doors swung open, and someone called her name. Walking in, Fiona relaxed a bit. "It's now or never," she whispered, trying to make herself feel brave. Standing on the stage and saying her lines, she began to feel sure of herself again. Not only did she recite every line perfectly, but she also delivered them with immense passion. Coming off the stage, she couldn't help but smile. "I did it. I really did it," she thought, surprised at how the audition had gone.

det.korean: rehearsal=리허설 / audition=오디션 / ceremony=의식 / interview=면접
det.analysis:

② audition: 오디션 — 배역/일에 적합한지 정하기 위한 짧은 실연 ←정답
③ ceremony: 의식 — 공연 선발과 무관
④ interview: 면접 — 실연(performance)이 아니라 질의응답
det.tip: 배우·가수·무용수가 배역 선발을 위해 하는 짧은 실연 = audition(오디션)

det.korean: flutter(동사: 파닥거리다) → fluttering. were 뒤 과거진행형(be + -ing)이므로 현재분사 필요
det.analysis: flutter를 현재분사 fluttering으로 변환. 'butterflies were fluttering' = '나비가 파닥거리고 있었다' — be동사(were) 뒤 진행형을 만들려면 현재분사(-ing)가 와야 함
det.tip: were __________ 구조 = 과거진행형 → 현재분사(-ing) → fluttering

questions.passage: Coming off the stage, she couldn't help but smile. "I did it. I really did it," she thought, __________ (surprise) at how the audition had gone.

det.korean: surprise(동사: 놀라게 하다) → surprised. 사람이 '놀란' 감정을 나타내는 과거분사(감정형용사)
det.analysis: surprise를 과거분사 surprised로 변환. 'she thought, surprised at ~' = '그녀는 ~에 놀라며 생각했다' — 사람이 감정을 느끼는 주체일 때 과거분사(-ed)로 '놀란' 상태를 나타냄
